PluginData.Author: LoneWolf2K
PluginData.Tooltip: Unload docks, name-tag cargo sorting ([Ore], [Parts P1], [Si] ...), status LCDs and automatic weapon ammo.
PluginData.Description:
Automatic cargo handling for Space Engineers 2. Everything works by renaming blocks.
Unload docks: name a connector [Unload] and docked ships drop their ore and ice ([Unload All] for everything). Sorting: name containers [Ore], [Ice], [Parts], [Ammo], [Tools], [Consumables], [Player], [Cells], [Misc], with priority like [Ore P1]. Single items: [Si], [Iron Ore], [Steel Plate]. Production output is collected from smelters, refineries, assemblers, fabricators and Gearforges. LCD screens: [Cargo], [Ore], [Parts], [Power], [Power Sources], [Power Consumers], [Damage], [Turrets], [Alerts]. Power and gas planning: what everything uses at full load and what to build when you are short. Weapon ammo: a Gearforge named [Make Ammo] keeps ammo for all turrets, guns and rocket launchers in stock. Alerts: full storage and tagged blocks without a conveyor link.
Items only move through conveyors. Turrets, reactors, production inputs and unknown blocks are never emptied. Single player (multiplayer not tested yet). Don't combine with other sorting plugins.
Manual: https://github.com/lwolf1965/LW-Cargo-Manager/blob/main/Docs/UserManual.md Bugs and ideas: https://github.com/lwolf1965/LW-Cargo-Manager/issues
